correctness.rationale: For five symbols and exactly seven length-three words, rederived the IPP1 triple condition (35 label triples) and IPP2 disjoint-pair condition (105 pairings), from the primary theorem. A fresh independent partition search over all 855 partitions of seven labels into at most five blocks found exactly 210 coordinate-unordered valid triples; Hamming graph signatures split them 105/105 into distinct classes with nine vs seven distance-two pairs, and the displayed two representatives occur. Each class has 105 distinct labeled equality triples and stabilizer 48; assigning five symbols per coordinate and three coordinate orders gives 210*6*(5!)^3/7!=432000 literal maximum codes, 216000 each class. Primary Tô–Safavi-Naini Theorem 34 gives the separate upper bound F(3,5)=7. Complete finite enumeration is exhaustive, not a probabilistic sample.
